sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By accessing or using HopeRise, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our services.

sections.heading: 2. Description of Service
sections.content: HopeRise provides a platform for individuals and organizations to create fundraising campaigns and receive donations. We act as an intermediary between campaign organizers and donors.

sections.heading: 3. User Responsibilities
sections.content: Users are responsible for providing accurate information, using the platform lawfully, and not engaging in fraudulent activities. Campaign organizers must use funds as described in their campaigns.

sections.heading: 4. Donations
sections.content: All donations are voluntary. HopeRise does not guarantee that campaigns will reach their goals or that funds will be used as intended. Donors should exercise due diligence before contributing.

sections.heading: 5. Fees
sections.content: HopeRise is free for organizers. Payment processing fees may apply. Optional tips to support our platform are appreciated but not required.

sections.heading: 6. Prohibited Activities
sections.content: Users may not use HopeRise for illegal activities, fraud, harassment, or any purpose that violates these terms or applicable laws.

sections.heading: 7. Limitation of Liability
sections.content: HopeRise is not liable for any damages arising from the use of our platform, including but not limited to direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages.

sections.heading: 8. Changes to Terms
sections.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the platform constitutes acceptance of modified terms.

sections.heading: 9. Contact
sections.content: For questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us at legal@hoperise.com

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect information you provide directly (name, email, payment information) and automatically (IP address, browser type, device information, usage data).

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.content: We use your information to provide and improve our services, process donations, communicate with you, and ensure platform security.

sections.heading: 3. Information Sharing
sections.content: We share information with campaign organizers (donor name unless anonymous), payment processors, and service providers. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.heading: 4. Data Security
sections.content: We implement industry-standard security measures including encryption, secure servers, and regular security audits to protect your data.

sections.heading: 5. Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to access, correct, delete, or export your personal data. Contact us to exercise these rights.

sections.heading: 6. Cookies
sections.content: We use cookies to improve your experience. See our Cookie Policy for more details.

sections.heading: 7. Children's Privacy
sections.content: Our services are not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect information from children.

sections.heading: 8. Contact
sections.content: For privacy-related inquiries, contact us at privacy@hoperise.com

sections.heading: What Are Cookies?
sections.content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit our website. They help us provide a better user experience.

sections.heading: Types of Cookies We Use
sections.content: Essential Cookies: Required for basic site functionality. Analytics Cookies: Help us understand how visitors use our site. Preference Cookies: Remember your settings and preferences. Marketing Cookies: Used to deliver relevant advertisements.

sections.heading: Managing Cookies
sections.content: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Note that disabling certain cookies may affect site functionality.

sections.heading: Third-Party Cookies
sections.content: Some cookies are placed by third-party services like payment processors and analytics providers.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.content: For questions about our cookie practices, contact us at privacy@hoperise.com

sections.heading: Donation Refunds
sections.content: Donations are generally non-refundable as they are transferred to campaign organizers. However, we may issue refunds in certain circumstances.

sections.heading: Eligible Refund Situations
sections.content: Fraudulent campaign (verified by our team), duplicate charge due to technical error, unauthorized transaction, or campaign cancelled before funds disbursed.

sections.heading: Refund Process
sections.content: To request a refund, contact our support team within 30 days of your donation. Provide your transaction details and reason for the request.

sections.heading: Processing Time
sections.content: Approved refunds are typically processed within 5-10 business days. The time to appear in your account depends on your payment provider.

sections.heading: Platform Tips
sections.content: Tips to HopeRise are non-refundable but may be credited toward future donations upon request.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.content: For refund requests, contact support@hoperise.com
